reason: A dsh provider integration that connects chat and model selection to Command Code through its streaming endpoint, with API-key authentication, model discovery caching, reasoning options, and supported image input.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Command Code，为聊天提供模型注册、流式生成、模型发现、推理选项和受支持的图像输入。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Command Code for chat with provider registration, streaming generation, model discovery, reasoning options, and supported image input.

capabilities: Connects to Command Code streaming and model-catalog HTTP endpoints
Authenticates requests using a user-provided API key or configured local credential sources
Caches discovered model metadata on the local host
Forwards supported image inputs to the external model service
Registers a Command Code LLM provider and exposes related chat commands
